targetScope: Choose the cheapest next WS2 discriminator for the current residual from protocol-compatible compact failure-response evidence; this contract does not estimate solver efficacy.
primaryQuantities: exact attempt work/node dose by action and stage
stopRule: Stage A may select a route only under the frozen routing rules in the preflight. If automatic compact response does not discriminate, advance only to the bounded compact-diagnostic Stage B. If Stage B remains diffuse or mirrors controls, route none.

instrument.calibrationNote: Automatic compact failure-response is the low-overhead broad instrument; rich capture remains a separate selected microscope.
abstentionConditions: deadline-truncated, harness-error, malformed, missing, and unknown outcomes remain indeterminate
unknown or mixed protocol/solver identity is ineligible for primary routing
failure-specific nominations require protocol-compatible solved controls

calibration.caveat: Hosted timing and payload values are bounded calibration evidence for the tested producer/search shape, not universal constants.

refreshTriggers: solver revision materially changes the relevant action/stage semantics
current residual population boundary changes materially
compact failure-response semantics or observer instrumentation changes materially

reproducibility.note: The offline reducer and routing envelope are deterministic for the same compact-response inputs and frozen analysis contract; hosted acquisition timing is outside this claim.

targetEnvelope.benchmarkObjective: inform the next WS2 discriminator choice for the current production residual
targetEnvelope.confirmationPopulation: protocol-compatible post-instrumentation compact-response population when available

adaptiveLineage.selectionEvent: A route is chosen only after Stage-A/Stage-B observations are visible.
adaptiveLineage.consequence: Any selected rejection, first-loss, allocation, or 2x2 descendant must freeze its own design before treatment outcomes and cannot treat the reconnaissance population as untouched confirmation.

independenceVector.sampleData: parent-clustered; repeated records/attempts within one parent are dependent
independenceVector.sourceConstruction: not claimed by this routing screen
independenceVector.taskFramingPrompt: shared prespecified WS2 reconnaissance task framing and routing rules; no prompt-level independence is claimed
independenceVector.authorityContextExposure: shared current WS2 authorities, preflight, and failure-evidence vocabulary; no authority/context-exposure independence is claimed
independenceVector.criticalLibraryCode: analysis and compact-response normalization share Pathfinder research code; no critical-code independence is claimed

prospectiveExpectation.expectedShape: Stage A should select a frozen route only when protocol-compatible parent-level compact evidence exposes a route-specific concentration or contrast strong enough for the preflight rule; otherwise the expected disposition is bounded Stage B or no expensive follow-on.
surpriseConditions: A route-specific signal recurs across independent parents and differs materially from solved controls despite not being the route favored by prior WS2 narrative.
A protocol-compatible, sufficiently supported population produces a stable cross-parent pattern that none of the frozen route rules can represent.
prospectiveExpectation.anomalyPolicy: Protocol/solver identity conflicts, missingness contradictions, malformed rows, integrity failures, or instrument-support violations are anomalies that make evidence ineligible; they are not scientific surprises.

resolutionOutcomeInterpretation.routeSelected: select only under the frozen Stage-A/Stage-B routing rules
resolutionOutcomeInterpretation.routeNone: no expensive follow-on is earned; this does not imply no mechanism exists
resolutionOutcomeInterpretation.blocked: repair the named observability blocker before treating the routing screen as resolution-ready
